# Scroll syncs miss a grid that registers before its DOM, and nodes keyed by data-neo-id

## Context

#21152 fixed this race in `GridHorizontalScrollSync` and named `src/main/addon/ScrollSync.mjs:77` as the same binding pattern, then unreproduced. It now reproduces.

A probe on `dev` `537cfaf768` ran CardGridContainment's grid inside a Tab card, recording every `scroll` listener bound to grid views and vertical scrollbars from page start:
- In 7 of 8 fresh pages, the first grid's ScrollSync registration existed, while its own listener functions were on neither the live view nor the live scrollbar.
- The TreeGrid, created second, bound in 8 of 8.
- In the grid-focus fixture, whose grids mount with the page, all 8 runs bound.

## The Problem

`ScrollSync#register` binds through `addScrollListener` and `DomAccess.getElement(fromId)?.addEventListener('scroll', …)`: the view, and for a two-way registration the scrollbar too.

`Neo.grid.VerticalScrollbar#addScrollSync` registers on `afterSetMounted(true)`, after awaiting `getAddon()`. The call can therefore reach the main thread before the VDom worker's delta inserts the nodes. An absent node gets no listener, and nothing binds it later.

The grid hides the view's native vertical scrollbar, so the custom scrollbar is the one people see. In this state it stops following a wheel scroll of the view, and dragging it scrolls nothing.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/main/addon/ScrollSync.mjs`: `addScrollListener` (lines 75–79), `register` (149–184), `unregister`, `onScroll`, `lockNode` (two-way echo suppression), `syncTo`.
- `src/grid/VerticalScrollbar.mjs#addScrollSync` (lines 93–111) is its only caller.
- `src/main/DomAccess.mjs#getElement`: the lookup by Neo id for both DOM identity modes, `id` while `Neo.config.useDomIds` and `data-neo-id` otherwise.
- Design authority: the JSDoc of `register`, "Registers a scroll synchronization between two DOM nodes." A registration that binds no listener synchronizes nothing.

## The Fix

As #21153 did for the horizontal sync:
- ScrollSync listens to the document once, in the capture phase, since a scroll does not bubble.
- It routes each scroll by the Neo id of the node that scrolled, to the registrations whose source that node is.
- `register` and `unregister` keep that index instead of per-node listeners.
- `onScroll`, `lockNode` and `syncTo` keep their semantics.
- `destroy` unbinds the document listener.

## Scope extended (16 Nov, from @neo-gpt-emmy's Chromium check of #21160)

The first head of #21160 routed by `event.target.id`. Under `Neo.config.useDomIds: false`, the renderer writes the Neo id as `data-neo-id` and no DOM id, so that routing dropped every scroll.

#21153's routing in `GridHorizontalScrollSync`, already on `dev`, does the same. `dev`'s ScrollSync also read `event.target.id` for its echo lock, so in that mode a synced scroll bounced back.

The fix resolves a node's Neo id through one owner, `DomAccess.getNodeId()`, the inverse of `getElement()`, and both addons route by it.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.main.addon.ScrollSync#register` | its JSDoc | a registration syncs once its nodes exist, whatever the order of registration and insertion, and back when `twoWay` | none | JSDoc | unit; component spec |
| `Neo.main.DomAccess#getNodeId` | `getElement`'s identity modes | a node's Neo id: its `id` while `useDomIds`, its `data-neo-id` otherwise | `null` for a node without one | JSDoc | unit and browser arms with `useDomIds: false` |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A registration made before its nodes are in the document syncs the target once they are, and back when `twoWay`. Covered by a unit spec and a real-browser component spec.
- [ ] A node replaced under the same id keeps its sync, and `unregister` ends it while leaving other registrations syncing (unit).
- [ ] The two-way echo stays suppressed: a synced scroll does not bounce back (unit).
- [ ] Existing ScrollSync consumers pass: `ComponentCellScrollSync.spec.mjs`, `AddonTeardown`, `LockedColumns` and the worker departure specs.
- [ ] Under `useDomIds: false`, both ScrollSync and `GridHorizontalScrollSync` route by the node's Neo id, and ScrollSync's echo lock holds. Covered by unit and browser arms.

## Out of Scope

- The order between the App worker's addon calls and the VDom worker's deltas.
